title: OpenAI Hires Top Trump AI Official to Work on National Security
key_facts: Thomas Lind, former leader of AI policy at the White House's Office of the National Cyber Director (ONCD), has joined OpenAI, The Information reported on Friday 2 Oct 2026.
He joined this week and will lead cyber and strategic risk on OpenAI's national security policy team.
Per his LinkedIn profile he served at ONCD from April 2025 to June 2026, most recently as head of policy and senior advisor to the director.
OpenAI's national security policy team is led by Sasha Baker, a former deputy undersecretary of defense for policy under President Biden.
Baker told The Information the hire reflects OpenAI's continued investment in addressing the national security challenges of increasingly capable AI.
Politico reported in June that Lind planned to leave ONCD to spend more time with his family, amid a string of departures of White House tech policy leaders after Trump's 2 June AI executive order.
Reuters reported on 30 Sep 2026 that OpenAI is among AI developers facing an FTC investigation into potential dangers of AI to consumers.

why_it_matters_hint: OpenAI is adding a former White House cyber and AI policy official to its national security team while regulators look into AI dangers.
event_date: Week of 28 Sep to 2 Oct 2026 (Lind joined 'this week'); reported 2 Oct 2026.
notes: The Information page is paywalled (no text). Wrote from the PYMNTS summary of The Information's report. Lind left the White House in June 2026, so the pool headline's 'top Trump AI official' is stronger than the facts: he is a former policy head at one White House office.
